ar.title: دجاج مطبوخ بالزبادي مع النعناع
ar.intro: طبق فلسطيني، دجاج طري بصلصة زبادي مع نكهة النعناع.

steps.n1: قطّع الدجاج إلى قطع ناضرة واقليها بخفة بزيت الزيتون.
steps.n2: اخلط بياض البيضة بالزبادي لمنع تحمضه وأضفه عبر منخل على الدجاج.
steps.n3: تبّل واطهِ بدون غطاء لمدة حوالي 30 دقيقة.
steps.n4: غلّظ بنشا الذرة، انقل إلى طبق تقديم ورشّ النعناع عليه.

en.title: Chicken Simmered in Yogurt with Mint (Firakh Matbukha bi-l-Zabadi)
en.intro: Recipe 124, page 58 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Cut the chickens into neat joints and fry them lightly in olive oil.
steps.n2: Stir the egg white into the yogurt to keep it from splitting and press it through a sieve over the chicken.
steps.n3: Season and cook uncovered for about 30 minutes.
steps.n4: Thicken with the cornflour, move to a serving dish and sprinkle with the mint.

legacySteps: Cut the chickens into neat joints and fry them lightly in olive oil.
Stir the egg white into the yogurt to keep it from splitting and press it through a sieve over the chicken.
Season and cook uncovered for about 30 minutes.
Thicken with the cornflour, move to a serving dish and sprinkle with the mint.
